usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Belize, Monthly Economic Highlights August 2026 (notes)
usdRate.note: The Belize dollar has been fixed at BZD 2.00 per US dollar since May 1976; World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF gives 2.0 for 2025.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistical Institute of Belize, CPI release for September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: All-items CPI 126.2 in September 2026 against 120.5 a year earlier (4.7%); January-September average 3.1%, driven by transport and fuel.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG for Belize: 3.2, 6.3, 4.4, 3.3 and 1.1% in 2021-2025
inflation_projection.note: Belize has no inflation target (dollar fixed to the US dollar); the 2021-2025 average is 3.7% but the 10-year average is about 2%, so we plan with 3%.

policy_rate.note: The Central Bank of Belize sets no policy interest rate; under the fixed BZD 2 = USD 1 peg it uses reserve requirements and open market operations (CBB Monthly Economic Highlights, August 2026).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Belize, Monthly Economic Highlights August 2026, Table A.7 (domestic banks' weighted average interest rates)
savings_account_rate.note: Weighted average savings deposit rate 2.60% (savings/chequing 2.61%); the statutory minimum rate on savings deposits is 2.5%.

fdr_3m_rate.note: CBB tables give only an all-terms weighted time deposit rate (2.05% in August 2026), not a 3-month rate; no official 3-month figure found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Belize, Monthly Economic Highlights August 2026, Table A.7 (weighted average time deposit rate)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Weighted average rate on all time deposits (all terms) 2.05%; new time deposits over the past 12 months averaged 2.54%. No separate 1-year rate is published.

dps_rate.note: Searched CBB tables and regulator material: no monthly recurring deposit product rate is published for Belize.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Belize, Monthly Economic Highlights August 2026, Table A.7
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on all deposits 0.88% (demand deposits pay 0.12%); rolling 12-month rate on new deposits 1.78%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Searched CBB and Ministry of Finance material: no government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; government domestic debt is in Treasury bills and Treasury notes held mainly by the Central Bank, banks and institutions.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Belize, Quarterly Review March 2026 (open market operations)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Weighted average 91-day Treasury bill auction yield 0.595% in Q1 2026 (range 0.590-0.600%); later 2026 auction notices do not state yields.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Searched CBB publications: Belize Treasury notes are issued at fixed coupons but no 5-year market yield is published.

tbond_10y_rate.note: Searched CBB publications: no 10-year government bond yield is published for Belize.

tax_bank_interest.note: The Income and Business Tax (Amendment) Act 2024 (Act No. 40 of 2024) removed the tax on interest on time deposits, but the Act text could not be opened (National Assembly site suspended) and the treatment of savings interest was not confirmed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists in Belize to tax; interest on Government of Belize notes and bonds is reported as tax-exempt, but no primary source was read.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Central Bank of Belize, Deposit Insurance Act
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposit Insurance Act 2020 covers depositors of domestic banks and credit unions up to BZD 20,000. The Act dates from January 2020 (older than 2025) and the CBB page does not confirm the fund is paying out yet.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Searched CBB and government sources: no legal cap on credit card interest found (the CBB has proposed a cap only for moneylenders); no official typical rate is published.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No Belize stock exchange; global equity index in US dollars (BZD is pegged)
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund held in pegged dollars over a weak decade; there is no local stock market and buying foreign assets needs exchange control approval.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No Belize stock exchange; global equity index in US dollars (BZD is pegged); savings rate 2.60%
equity_return_base.note: Base case on a global index in US-dollar terms, kept within 4 points of the 2.6% safe savings rate since there is no local market.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No Belize stock exchange; global equity index in US dollars (BZD is pegged)
equity_return_high.note: High case near the long-run nominal US-dollar return of global shares.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Belize dollar fixed at BZD 2 = USD 1 since 1976 (Central Bank of Belize)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price; the peg means no currency boost.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Belize dollar fixed at BZD 2 = USD 1 since 1976 (Central Bank of Belize)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% a year, with no expected depreciation under the fixed peg.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Belize dollar fixed at BZD 2 = USD 1 since 1976 (Central Bank of Belize)
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold, or a peg under stress.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: Treasury bill yields of about 0.6%.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CBB Monthly Economic Highlights Aug 2026: savings 2.60%, time deposits 2.05%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of savings (statutory minimum 2.5%) and time deposits around 2%; interest tax on deposits removed or minor.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: CBB Monthly Economic Highlights Aug 2026: new time deposits 2.54% (12-month rolling)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: negotiated longer time deposits at about 3%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Searched OSIPP insurance statistics and annual reports: no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio is published.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is sold in Belize, but no regulator or public source publishes premium rates by age; only individual insurer quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Searched Ministry of Health and Wellness, NHI and public sources: no official typical private hospital bill is published (only expat-guide estimates).

health_premium_table.note: Searched OSIPP and public sources: no published private health insurance premiums by age.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CBB Monthly Economic Highlights Aug 2026, Table A.20: health sub-index up 5.2% year to date
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices are rising faster than the headline CPI (5.2% vs 2.9% year to date), so we plan with the 3% projection plus 1.5 points.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CBB Monthly Economic Highlights Aug 2026, Table A.20: education services up 1.0% year to date
goal_inflation_education.note: Education services rose only 1% in 2026, but fees move in steps, so we plan with the headline projection plus half a point.

life_expectancy.note: UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 74.1 for 2026 (men 71.4, women 77.0).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.6 (2025, World Bank), 13.2 (2040) and 33.8 (2065, populationpyramid.net/belize/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: SSB retirement pension from 65 whether working or not, or from 60 if no longer employed; the review does not recommend raising pension ages now. No statutory private-sector retirement age.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Amandala: GoB and the retirement age (editorial on the public service retirement age)
retirement_age_government.note: Public officers retire at 55 under the Pensions Act; the government cited an IMF recommendation to raise it to 65 in the 2023/24 budget, but no enacted change was found (source from 2023, older than 2025).

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: Treasury bills or demand-like deposits around 0.6%.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: CBB Monthly Economic Highlights Aug 2026: time deposits 2.05%, savings 2.60%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case at the weighted 2.05% time deposit rate, the safe 1-year rate available (deposit interest tax removed or minor).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CBB Monthly Economic Highlights Aug 2026: new time deposits 2.54% (12-month rolling)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: negotiated longer time deposits around 3%.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Savings rate 2.60%; global equity in pegged dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix dominated by deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Savings rate 2.60%; global equity in pegged dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of deposits at 2-2.6% and some global equity, limited by exchange controls on foreign investment.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Savings rate 2.60%; global equity in pegged dollars
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case with a larger global equity share.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Social Security Board, 2025 Actuarial Review (July 2026), section 5.1.5 Non-Contributory Pension
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: BZD 100 a month, unchanged since 2007; paid to just over 800 people in 2025.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Social Security Board, 2025 Actuarial Review (July 2026), section 5.1.5 Non-Contributory Pension
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Women 65+ and men 67+ born or naturalised Belizean with no income or adequate support; only one person per household, and no one else in the home may receive an SSB pension. A single age for both sexes is under consideration.

gratuity_rule.sourceName: Caribbean Court of Justice, [2025] CCJ 14 (AJ) BZ, quoting Labour Act Cap. 297 s.183
gratuity_rule.note: Severance on retirement at 60+ (or medical grounds) or termination: one week's wages per year with 5-10 years' service; two weeks per year with over 10 years (one week for service before 2012). Resigning after 10 years gives an equal gratuity. A week is modelled as 6 of 26 working days a month. The CCJ held in November 2025 that retirees qualify.

public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory social security for employed and self-employed people from 14; 10% contribution (split by wage band). Pension from 65 (60 if not working) with 500 contributions, 30% of best-3-year average insurable earnings plus 2% per 50 weeks from 500 to 750. Pensions are not indexed (adjusted only once, in 2016).

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the Central Bank; held mainly by banks and the Central Bank.

tbond_5y.note: Fixed-coupon notes issued through the Central Bank; no market yield published.

tbond_10y.note: Long-dated notes exist but no 10-year yield is published.

equity_fund.note: Belize has no stock exchange and no retail mutual fund market was found; investing abroad needs exchange control approval.

gold.note: No legal restriction on buying gold; mostly sold as jewellery.

insuranceRegulator.name: Office of the Supervisor of Insurance and Private Pensions (OSIPP)

publicHealthCover.name: National Health Insurance (NHI), being rolled out district by district

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Insurance Act (Central Bank of Belize)
